# pocketfft (C++ header-only version)

`pocketfft_hdronly.h` and `LICENSE.md` from the `cpp` branch of
https://github.com/mreineck/pocketfft, commit
4d865cba24359b05b37da4e75aee24498c3b78e7 (2026-10-18), unchanged.
BSD-3-Clause, see `LICENSE.md` and the header of the file.

Used by the GLARE image pipeline plugin
(`src/slg/film/imagepipeline/plugins/glare.cpp`) for the FFT convolution of
the image with the point spread function of the lens.
